name: East Asian Studies
notes: Five courses (three foundational surveys, two electives) and no prerequisites. Designed for students with a strong interest in East Asia who are not planning to learn an East Asian language.
THERE IS NO 'EST' COURSE PREFIX: East Asian Studies is interdisciplinary and every course belongs to a contributing department (AHST, ANTH, CHIN, HIST, JPNS, RELC).
Language courses cannot count toward the elective requirement, and no course may serve as both a foundational survey and an elective - the groups below do not share courses.
Several HIST options were last offered in 2024-25 (HIST 143, 145, 195, 200, 346).

requirementGroups.label: Foundational survey: pre-modern East Asia
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students must take three foundational survey courses, one each group (A, B, and C). Group A-Pre-modern East Asia: AHST 142: Arts of East Asia; AHST 115: Arts of China; CHIN 214: Dream of the Red Chamber; CHIN 216: Social Turmoil and Civic Responsibility; CHIN 219: Monsters, Ghosts, Fairies, and Gods; HIST 195: Premodern Japan (last offered 2024-5); RELC 105: Asian Search for Self; RELC 106: From Confucius to Zen; RELC 174: Chinese Religions; RELC 269: Reinventing Bodhisattvas and God in China

requirementGroups.label: Foundational survey: modern East Asia
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Group B-Modern East Asia: AHST 268: Media, Reform and Revolution in China; CHIN 217: Volatility and Change in 20th Century Chinese Literature; CHIN 222: Gender, Sexuality, and Desire in 20th Century Chinese Literature; HIST 143: Modern China; HIST 145: Modern Japan; HIST 200: Gateway: Japanese Empire and its Afterlives; HIST 346: East Asia and the Cold War; JPNS 214: Atomic Creatures: Godzilla; JPNS 219: Tourist Japan; JPNS 226: I am a Cat: Self-Writing in Japanese Literature

requirementGroups.label: Foundational survey: contemporary East Asia
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Group C-Contemporary East Asia: ANTH 257: Contemporary Chinese Society; CHIN 223: Memory and Meaning in Post-Mao Literature; JPNS 237: East Asian Metropolises in Literature and Film; JPNS 245: Japanese Science Fiction and Planetary Possible Futures; JPNS 293: Life and Anime; RELC 175: Religion and Chinese Society

requirementGroups.label: Two electives at the 200 level or higher
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Electives (Two Courses): Students should choose two electives at the 200 level or higher from the list below. Language courses cannot be counted toward fulfilling the elective requirement for the minor. The same course cannot be used both as a foundational core course and an elective course.
requirementGroups.note: The page calls its elective list a sample - ask your EST faculty advisor about anything not on it.
